summaries.name: Trello
summaries.summary: Trello is a visual task management tool using boards, lists, and cards to organize tasks and projects, useful for breaking larger tasks into smaller chunks.

summaries.name: Any.do
summaries.summary: Any.do is a simple, intuitive app for creating to-do lists, setting reminders, and collaborating with others.

summaries.name: Google Calendar
summaries.summary: Google Calendar can integrate tasks and events for a clear daily overview, and can be used to create recurring yoga practice events with reminders (e.g., every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 7:00 am, with a reminder 10-15 minutes beforehand).

summaries.name: Apple Calendar
summaries.summary: Apple Calendar can integrate tasks and events for a clear daily overview, and can be used to create recurring yoga practice events with reminders.

summaries.name: Fantastical
summaries.summary: Fantastical is an iOS-only calendar app that integrates with tasks and reminders, offering a clean, intuitive interface.

summaries.name: Yoga Studio
summaries.summary: Yoga Studio is a comprehensive yoga app with classes, custom sequences, and a schedule feature to help plan a yoga practice.

summaries.name: Habitica
summaries.summary: Habitica is a habit-tracking app that gamifies daily tasks and activities, including exercise and yoga practice, and can be used to set reminders and track yoga practice progress.

summaries.name: Strides
summaries.summary: Strides is a goal-setting app that helps track progress toward objectives, including fitness and wellness goals like yoga practice.

summaries.name: Google Keep
summaries.summary: Google Keep (for Android) can be used to set phone reminders, such as recurring reminders for a Monday/Wednesday/Friday 7:00 am yoga practice at 6:50 am (10 minutes before).

summaries.name: HabitBull
summaries.summary: HabitBull is a habit-tracking app that can be used to set reminders for yoga practice and track progress.

summaries.name: Loop Habit Tracker
summaries.summary: Loop Habit Tracker is a habit-tracking app that can be used to set reminders for yoga practice and track progress.
